title: Ghost Candy Cards
summary: A Rust template, claim client and Python SVG printer for one-time Halloween candy cards. Each printed QR carries a bearer secret; the public bowl stores its corresponding point and records redemption, while the treat is paid to a stealth output. Claims bind the proof to the exact output, and the host can sweep unused treats after the deadline. Anyone who copies a card secret can race its holder; published demo secrets must not be funded. October 31 review covered the creator announcement and MIT README. The recording is a source walkthrough, not a deployed claim demonstration.
cardSummary: Print one-time QR candy cards that redeem private testnet treats while keeping the recipient off the public bowl.
